load_wav2vec2_model: load a pretrained Wav2Vec2 model from the fairseq2 model hub by name
create_wav2vec2_model: create a new Wav2Vec2 model from a Wav2Vec2Config using the model hub
list_wav2vec2_models: iterate over all available Wav2Vec2 model asset cards using the model hub
get_wav2vec2_archs: get the set of supported Wav2Vec2 model architectures from the model hub
get_wav2vec2_config: get the model configuration for a specific Wav2Vec2 model card or architecture
